project.name: Signal Exchange
project.summary: A self-contained data marketplace where WebMCP agents search, compare, and negotiate access while people retain the visible approval boundary, budget, and undo control.
project.ai_usage: Codex was the primary coding agent for product shaping, implementation, testing, deployment, visual QA, and video production. Hermes Agent independently reviewed the PRD. Image generation produced original concept references. The shipped application contains original code and deterministic local logic; it calls no model API.
project.codex_usage: Codex implemented the React and TypeScript marketplace, seven WebMCP tools, approval-bound transaction flow, tests, GitHub Pages release, accessibility and responsive QA, and the 65-second HyperFrames walkthrough.
